description: Prospectively frozen repeated-sampling benchmark of complete-profile equivalence/departure/unresolved rules; separate development/evaluation streams, no tuning from evaluation.
resource: Generated additive per-block resource totals in arbitrary resource units; zero bins retained. Population estimand is normalized arithmetic mean raw resource per fixed log-bin width.

eligibility.rules: A family/block-count/method passes only if every frozen profile shape has false-equivalence and false-departure Wilson upper bounds <=0.065 and coverage Wilson lower bound >=0.925. Centered and known-bound methods use simultaneous full-vector coverage; the percentile extension uses Delta interval coverage and is not a simultaneous-vector method. Coverage/decision criteria are operational tolerances, not a theorem or universal certification. Missing reference methods are unavailable, not passing.
eligibility.application: Any eligibility is restricted to the simulated observation model. Twelve observed seasonal months, unknown fluence tails, independence and absent physical resource bounds cannot be certified by a favorable simulated family. Solar's robust primary verdict remains unresolved unless its sampling assumptions are independently justified.

stream_recipe: SeedSequence([stage_data_seed, block_count_index, profile_index, observation_family_index]); independent bootstrap stream SeedSequence([bootstrap_seed, stage_index, block_count_index, profile_index, observation_family_index]). Corrected/misspecified detection share family index 3 for paired identical latent resources/inclusion draws, while all outer datasets within a scenario are independent. Stage indices: development 0, evaluation 1.
interpretation: Calibrates statistical operating characteristics for declared complete-profile targets and observation processes. Generating profiles and resource allocation are imposed; this is method validation, not evidence for autonomous allocation or a novel natural law.
